Document with only script tags produces empty output (scripts are stripped)

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<html><head><script>alert('xss')</script></head><body><script>document.write('hello')</script></body></html>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
